blurb: The Recreation Hub at 282 Main Street offers an equipment loan program featuring 20 new bikes including electrified models and a specialized e-trike with bench seating. Users must complete a waiver with proof of ID and credit card for borrowing. Staff provide bike safety and usage guidance and maps of the Active Transportation Network and local trails are available.
extraNote: Credit card information held only during loan period and destroyed upon return · 282 Main Street, across from Willow Park
